questions.stemEn: A child referred to your clinic after an anaphylactic reaction with urticaria and hypotension during a radiocontrast study one week ago. The family asks for advice regarding future radiocontrast studies. What should you tell them?

options.text: Provide premedication with antihistamine and steroid

questions.explanationAr: السؤال يصف severe immediate hypersensitivity reaction بعد radiocontrast مع urticaria و hypotension. حسب شرح المصدر، في الحالات الشديدة يُفكَّر أولًا في alternative study أو تجنب العامل المسبب، وإذا لم يوجد بديل مناسب يمكن التفكير في تغيير contrast agent مع premedication. لذلك إجابة التجميع هي تجنب radiocontrast في الزيارة غير الطارئة، لكن يلزم التحقق النهائي من أحدث التوصيات قبل النشر.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Premedication قد تُستخدم عندما لا يوجد بديل مقبول، لكنها ليست الخيار الأول في مريض لديه severe immediate reaction ويمكن تجنب contrast.
questions.clinicalPearl: Severe prior immediate contrast reaction requires an alternative-study-first strategy when feasible.

tts.text: A child referred to your clinic after an anaphylactic reaction with urticaria and hypotension during a radiocontrast study one week ago. The family asks for advice regarding future radiocontrast studies. What should you tell them? Option A, avoid radiocontrast. Option B, provide premedication with antihistamine and steroid.

questions.stemEn: A patient treated with an antibiotic for otitis media presented after 5 days with skin rash, lymphadenopathy and arthralgia. Which antibiotic was probably given?
questions.explanationAr: التركيبة rash + arthralgia + lymphadenopathy بعد عدة أيام من antibiotic تُناسب serum sickness-like reaction. المصدر يربطها بشكل كلاسيكي مع Cefaclor في الأطفال.
questions.clinicalPearl: Cefaclor is a classic pediatric trigger of serum sickness-like reactions.

tts.text: A patient treated with an antibiotic for otitis media presented after 5 days with skin rash, lymphadenopathy and arthralgia. Which antibiotic was probably given? Option A, Cefaclor.

questions.stemEn: A child presented with toxic epidermal necrolysis with 40% involvement of body surface area. How will you manage him?
questions.explanationAr: وجود TEN مع 40% BSA يعني severe disease ويحتاج specialized center/PICU أو burn-level supportive care. الأساس هو wound care, fluid and electrolyte management, nutrition, temperature control, pain control, ocular care ومراقبة organ dysfunction. المصدر لا يدعم IVIG كـ monotherapy روتيني.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: IVIG وحده ليس العلاج الأساسي حسب شرح المصدر، ودور systemic steroids غير محسوم ولا يسبق supportive intensive care في هذه الحالة الشديدة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Extensive SJS/TEN is primarily an intensive supportive-care emergency.

tts.text: A child presented with toxic epidermal necrolysis with forty percent involvement of body surface area. How will you manage him? Option A, PICU admission for supportive care. Option B, IVIG. Option C, oral steroid.

questions.stemEn: A 2-month-old boy on formula and breastfeeding presented with blood in stool. He looks well and active and has no other findings. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: Well-appearing young infant مع blood-streaked stool ووجود formula feeding يناسب food protein-induced allergic proctocolitis، وغالبًا يكون cow's milk protein هو السبب.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Infectious colitis غالبًا يصاحبه illness أو fever أو systemic/GI symptoms أكثر. Blood in stool ليس finding طبيعيًا يُطمأن عليه دون تفسير.
questions.clinicalPearl: Food protein-induced proctocolitis typically affects otherwise well young infants.

tts.text: A two-month-old boy on formula and breastfeeding presented with blood in stool. He looks well and active and has no other findings. What is the most likely diagnosis? Option A, cow milk protein allergy. Option B, infectious colitis. Option C, normal for his age.

questions.stemEn: A 4-month-old infant presented with blood in stool. He has good weight gain with no other significant findings. His mother is giving formula feeding along with breastfeeding and introduced solid foods one week ago. What will you do next?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار trial of exclusive breastfeeding في هذا السيناريو المختلط breast + formula، بما يتماشى مع الاشتباه في cow's milk protein–related proctocolitis. هذه الصياغة تحتاج مراجعة تفصيلية قبل النشر لأن الخطة الدقيقة تعتمد على نوع feeding والتخلص من cow-milk protein exposure.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: إيقاف breastfeeding بالكامل غير مدعوم من شرح المصدر.
questions.clinicalPearl: Management depends on whether the infant is breastfed, formula-fed, or mixed-fed.

tts.text: A four-month-old infant presented with blood in stool. He has good weight gain with no other significant findings. His mother is giving formula feeding along with breastfeeding and introduced solid foods one week ago. What will you do next? Option A, trial of exclusive breast milk. Option B, discontinue breastfeeding.

questions.stemEn: A 4-month-old infant presented with blood in stool. He is on both breast and formula feed. His mother recently introduced food. What will you do next for him?
questions.explanationAr: في infant يستخدم formula، المصدر يذكر استبدال cow's milk/soy formula بـ extensively hydrolyzed formula عند الاشتباه في cow's milk protein allergy.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Gluten-free diet لا يعالج cow's milk protein allergy. Reassurance وحدها غير كافية مع persistent bloody stool. صياغة 'exclusive dairy diet' لا تمثل elimination therapy.
questions.clinicalPearl: Extensively hydrolyzed formula is a standard elimination option for formula-fed infants with cow's milk protein allergy.
managementSteps: Replace standard cow-milk formula with extensively hydrolyzed formula

tts.text: A four-month-old infant presented with blood in stool. He is on both breast and formula feed. His mother recently introduced food. What will you do next for him? Option A, start hydrolyzed formula. Option B, start exclusive dairy diet. Option C, start gluten free diet. Option D, reassurance.

questions.stemEn: A medical intern is asking you about food cross reactivity. Which of the following statement is right?

options.text: Oral allergy syndrome, with raw vegetables and fruit
Cow milk, not with goat milk

questions.explanationAr: Pollen-food syndrome أو oral allergy syndrome يحدث بسبب cross-reactive plant proteins، وغالبًا تظهر الأعراض بعد تناول raw fruits أو vegetables أو nuts. هذه allergens تكون عادة heat-labile، لذلك الأعراض تكون أوضح مع الطعام النيء.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Shellfish allergy ليست cross-reactive مع iodinated contrast. Peanut يمكن أن يترافق مع sensitization أو allergy لـ tree nuts. Cow milk proteins قد تتقاطع مع goat milk proteins.
questions.clinicalPearl: Pollen-food syndrome is typically triggered by raw plant foods because the relevant proteins are heat-labile.

tts.text: A medical intern is asking you about food cross reactivity. Which of the following statement is right? Option A, oral allergy syndrome with raw vegetables and fruit. Option B, shellfish with contrast. Option C, peanut not with tree nut. Option D, cow milk not with goat milk.

questions.stemEn: A child with egg allergy presents before receiving the MMR vaccine. The mother asks for your advice. What will you tell her?

options.text: He can receive the vaccine safely
The child should stay under observation for 2 hours after receiving the vaccine

questions.explanationAr: Egg allergy ليست contraindication لـ MMR/MMRV حسب شرح المصدر. لا يلزم routine skin testing أو prolonged observation فقط بسبب egg allergy.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: اعتبار MMR contraindicated بسبب egg allergy غير صحيح حسب المصدر، وكذلك prolonged observation لمدة ساعتين ليست مطلوبة بشكل روتيني.
questions.clinicalPearl: Egg allergy alone is not a contraindication to MMR vaccination.

tts.text: A child with egg allergy presents before receiving the MMR vaccine. The mother asks for your advice. What will you tell her? Option A, he can receive the vaccine safely. Option B, vaccine is contraindicated. Option C, the child should stay under observation for two hours after receiving the vaccine.

questions.topic: Yellow fever vaccine and egg allergy
questions.stemEn: A mother of a 4-month-old boy who has egg allergy is asking about which vaccine should be avoided?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يميز yellow fever vaccine عن MMR وinfluenza في سياق egg allergy ويذكر الحاجة إلى allergy evaluation/skin testing قبل إعطائه في بعض الحالات. لذلك التجميع اختار Yellow fever، لكن صياغة 'should be avoided' تحتاج تحديثًا دقيقًا قبل النشر لأنها قد تعتمد على شدة الحساسية وإمكانية graded administration.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: MMR ليست contraindicated بسبب egg allergy حسب المصدر. Influenza vaccine يمكن إعطاؤه في egg-allergic patients وفق الإرشادات الحديثة، وVaricella ليست egg-based vaccine.
questions.clinicalPearl: Yellow fever vaccine requires special consideration in patients with egg allergy.

tts.text: A mother of a four-month-old boy who has egg allergy is asking about which vaccine should be avoided? Option A, MMR. Option B, Varicella. Option C, Influenza. Option D, Yellow fever.

questions.stemEn: A picture was provided for a skin prick test. Which of the following is true regarding this test?

options.text: It is not affected by antihistamine pre-use
It is always positive in children
The reaction is type 1 hypersensitivity reaction

questions.explanationAr: Skin prick testing يُستخدم لتقييم IgE-mediated immediate hypersensitivity، أي Type I hypersensitivity. Antihistamines قد تثبط skin reactivity لعدة أيام، لذلك option A غير صحيح. كما أن الاختبار ليس دائمًا positive في الأطفال.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Antihistamines قد تقلل الاستجابة الجلدية، والاختبار ليس دائم الإيجابية.
questions.clinicalPearl: Skin prick testing assesses immediate IgE-mediated hypersensitivity and can be suppressed by antihistamines.
